hypotheses.basis: The word 'must' is read as creating an unconditional obligation on the agent to obtain the user id, independent of whether a booking update is attempted. The update permission is separate and not contingent on the id in this reading.
unresolved_terms: whether the obligation to obtain the id is triggered only by intent to update or is absolute
what 'before any booking update' modifies if the obligation is unconditional

hypotheses.basis: The phrase 'must obtain that id before any booking update' is read as establishing a conditional obligation rather than a conditional permission: the agent is always permitted to perform a booking update (permission is not gated by the id), but when they do, they incur an obligation to have obtained the id. The violation is an obligation failure, not a permission breach. This differs from the existing conditional-permission reading because the update action itself remains authorized regardless of id status.
unresolved_terms: whether obligation violation and permission violation carry different consequences

hypotheses.basis: The phrase 'before any booking update' is read as establishing a necessary precondition that lifts a prohibition, without itself granting permission. Obtaining the id removes the barrier to updating, but the permission to update must come from elsewhere (e.g., 'Other booking fields are listed here' may imply a separate authorization source). This policy alone provides no positive permission clause.
